subject.title: Auto-apply safe doctor fixes on gateway start

question: Which doctor repair mutations may Gateway startup run unattended, and which security-, channel-, provider-, auth-, or plugin-affecting repairs must require explicit opt-in or remain manual?
rationale: Source inspection shows the requested behavior is absent, but existing doctor repair can change security and delivery-sensitive config; maintainers must set the product/security boundary before implementation.

options.title: Classify a safe startup subset
options.body: Define an allowlist of unattended-safe repairs, keep broad doctor repair manual, and require redacted audit logging plus backup details for any startup write.

options.title: Add explicit opt-in auto-fix
options.body: Add a compatibility-reviewed config or CLI policy knob that enables broader startup repair only for operators who accept the security and delivery tradeoff.

options.title: Keep startup repair manual
options.body: Document supervisor preflight patterns and leave normal Gateway startup read-only until broader recovery policy is settled.

recommendation.title: Classify a safe startup subset
recommendation.body: Define an allowlist of unattended-safe repairs, keep broad doctor repair manual, and require redacted audit logging plus backup details for any startup write.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history across Gateway startup and config/doctor hardening, which are the surfaces needing the policy decision.
